remarks: Enjoy the vibrant urban lifestyle of downtown Stamford in this beautifully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo. With gleaming hardwood floors throughout, an updated kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, and large windows offering panoramic views of downtown, this home blends style with comfort. It even includes a brand new water heater.  Located just steps away from Stamford's best restaurants, shops, and entertainment, and within walking distance of the train station, this condo is a commuter's dream. The building boasts a top-tier gym, outdoor space perfect for relaxing, and a spacious community room for social gatherings.  Whether you're looking for convenience, modern amenities, or a city-chic vibe, this condo has it all. Don't miss the chance to make downtown Stamford your new home!
